What is FinanceOS?
Version v7.1.2
FinanceOS is a personal finance dashboard that runs in your browser on computer, tablet and phone. Record what you earn, spend, owe and invest, and it turns that into live charts, summaries and alerts so you can see where you stand at a glance. Your data is kept on your device first, and can also be synced to your cloud account or backed up as JSON — you choose in Data Tracking Mode.
What’s inside
Everything FinanceOS can do
Dashboard
Live overview: totals, cash flow, spending mix, portfolio and credit charts, market ticker, milestone badges.
Transactions
Income and expenses with filters and custom tags; debt and emergency-fund entries kept separate.
Investments
Gold, silver, real estate, mutual funds, bonds, stocks, crypto, FDs and RDs with analytics.
Loans & EMI
Track every loan, its EMI and what you still owe.
Credit Tracker & CC Utilization
Credit entries and how much of each card limit you use.
Budgets
Monthly limits per category with live progress.
Analytics & Net Worth
Spending patterns and assets-minus-liabilities over time.
Scenario, Rough Board & Calculator
SIP planner, quick spreadsheet and a built-in scientific calculator.
Insurance & Subscriptions
Policies (personal/corporate) and recurring subscriptions in one place.
Notes
Keep notes next to your finances.
Fin AI
Financial health score and insights from your own data.
Notifications
Alerts for large transactions, unusual spending and reminders.
Cloud, JSON & Drive saving
Cloud sync, manual JSON backup/restore and Drive auto-save, chosen via Data Tracking Mode.
Device Lock
Face ID, fingerprint, passkey or PC Lock to protect this device.
User Guide (PDF)
A simple manual: getting started, every section, backups and security. Works offline.
Data Storage & Privacy
Where your data actually lives, and who can see it
Local Storage
A full copy of your data is kept in this browser's Local Storage, so the app loads instantly and keeps working offline.
Always on
Cloud Storage (Supabase)
While signed in, that same data is synced to your private account in the cloud — this is what lets your phone and PC show the same numbers.
Checking…
Third-Party Analytics & Ads
No data is sold, shared, or sent to any third-party analytics, tracking, or advertising service — it only ever moves between you and your own account.
None
Earlier versions of this page described FinanceOS as "local-first" with "zero cloud dependencies." That stopped being accurate once account sign-in and cross-device sync were added — the rows above reflect how it actually works today: local-first for speed, cloud-backed for continuity.
Cloud Account Security
How your synced data and your sign-in are protected
Encryption In Transit
Everything sent to and from the cloud travels over HTTPS/TLS.
Encrypted
Row-Level Access Control
Your records are scoped to your account at the database level — no other FinanceOS user can query, see, or export your data.
Account-scoped
Device Lock (this device)
Face ID / Fingerprint / Passkey and PC Lock — manage these under Account & Profile.
Off

Choose how FinanceOS saves and tracks your financial data.
